rows.commentary: 6.5: Arafat Minhas loops it up on middle and off, and Kamindu Mendis steps forward to clip it straight to mid-wicket.
6.6: Arafat Minhas tosses this delivery on off, allowing Kamindu Mendis to punch it down to long-on for a single.
7.1: Shaheen Afridi lands it on a good length just outside off, met by a leaning defensive push from Kamindu Mendis into the off-side.
7.2: Shaheen Afridi probes with a fuller delivery outside off, steered firmly off the front foot straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
7.3: Shaheen Afridi pulls back his length outside off, and Kamindu Mendis angles the bat to dead-bat it toward the off-side.
7.4: Shaheen Afridi angles one into the left-hander from a length, nudged by Kamindu Mendis behind square on the on-side for a comfortable single.
7.5: Shaheen Afridi shortens his delivery and angles it across the right-hander, leaving Avishka Fernando to watch it pass.
7.6: Shaheen Afridi finds extra fullness outside off as Avishka Fernando drives loosely, skewing a thick edge off the bottom hand down to third man for a single.
8.1: Arafat Minhas fires it flatter and quicker onto the pads, completely beating Avishka Fernando's attempted flick.
8.2: Arafat Minhas tosses it up around off, and Avishka Fernando takes a half-stride forward to execute a solid defense.
8.3: Arafat Minhas floats this one just outside off, inviting Avishka Fernando to punch it straight back at the bowler.
8.4: Arafat Minhas tosses one up invitingly outside off, drawing Avishka Fernando into a drive down toward long-off for a comfortable single.
8.5: Arafat Minhas loops it up outside off, finding subtle turn into Kamindu Mendis, who dead-bats it securely into the leg-side.
8.6: Taking pace off at 89kph, Minhas darts one onto off-stump as Kamindu retreats onto the back foot to steer it toward midwicket.
9.1: Shaheen Afridi digs it in short, keeping it low, and Avishka Fernando pats a controlled pull over mid-wicket for a single.
9.2: Shaheen Afridi drops short, and Kamindu Mendis swivels effortlessly to launch the pull over backward square leg for a maximum that registers his fifty.
9.3: Shaheen rolls his fingers across a slower bouncer that catches Kamindu early on the hook, trickling off an inside edge safely short of the keeper.
9.4: Shaheen drifts a low full-toss in at the left-hander, prompting Kamindu to prod across the line and dab it towards mid-on.
9.5: Shaheen hammers another short delivery into the batter, allowing Kamindu to punch it down to long leg for a comfortable single.
20.2: Haris Rauf delivers at 140.1ks, but Kamindu Mendis checks his drive exquisitely to steer the ball past a diving Naseem at mid-off for four.
20.3: Haris Rauf pulls back his length to 136.9ks, cramping the batter before Mendis drops it softly into the off-side to sprint through for a quick single.
20.4: Haris Rauf digs a sharp bouncer close to off-stump, forcing Mendis to sink down and watch it sail harmlessly over him.
20.5: Haris Rauf lands a 136.4ks back-of-a-length delivery, which Mendis punches firmly toward backward point where Arafat makes an athletic stop.
20.6: Haris Rauf pitches slightly too full, and the Sri Lankan captain Kusal Mendis presents the full face of the bat to launch a commanding six straight down the ground.
21.1: Salman Agha tosses one up at 83.8ks outside off, allowing Mendis to drive in front of square for a single as the sweeper tidies up.
21.2: Salman Agha watches Kusal Mendis come down the pitch and almost york himself, squeezing the ball away to the cover region.
21.3: Salman Agha claims a stunning caught-and-bowled wicket as Kusal Mendis smokes it straight back, only for Agha to pluck a sensational reflex catch out of thin air.
21.4: Salman Agha tosses it up around off-stump, and Rathnayake safely blocks it down into the off-side.
21.5: Salman Agha induces a moment of hesitation as Rathnayake works it to mid-wicket, but Shaheen's fumble lets them complete the single safely.
21.6: Salman Agha fires one in with width, and Mendis expertly dabs it away late past the fielder to pick up another boundary.
22.1: Naseem Shah charges in to send down a 133.2ks full delivery at the stumps, comfortably eased toward mid-on by Rathnayake.
22.2: Naseem Shah delivers a fullish 137.2kph ball, and Pavan Rathnayake solidly drills it straight to the mid-off fielder.
22.3: Naseem Shah drops it back of a length at 137.6kph, allowing Pavan Rathnayake to nudge it softly into the off-side and flip the strike.

22.4: Naseem Shah angles a fuller delivery away as Kamindu Mendis checks his drive, sending it dropping dangerously close before Agha gathers it on the half-volley at cover to leave the bowler gripping his head in disbelief.
22.5: Naseem Shah fires a full delivery across the left-hander, and Kamindu Mendis slices his drive behind square on the off-side to scamper back for two runs.
22.6: Naseem Shah charges in with a 138.8kph good length ball, solidly blocked by Kamindu Mendis just ahead of mid-off as he sprints across for a single.
32.2: Haris Rauf drifts onto the pads, allowing Kamindu Mendis to tuck it into the gap at mid-wicket and advance to ninety-eight.
32.3: Haris Rauf delivers a slower off-cutter, knocked securely toward wide mid-on by Pavan Rathnayake.
32.4: Haris Rauf drops it short on middle, and Mendis pulls it away cleanly to deep mid-wicket.
32.5: Haris Rauf offers a slightly shorter delivery, which Rathnayake reads early, clearing his back leg to smash across the line into the deep mid-wicket gap for four.
32.6: Haris Rauf serves up a short and wide ball, flayed on the up by Rathnayake toward sweeper cover.
33.1: Faheem Ashraf bowls back of a length outside off, safely cut away to sweeper cover by Rathnayake.
33.2: Faheem Ashraf bangs it short on off, and Mendis waits to upper glide it toward third man, bouncing over the ropes to seal a maiden ODI hundred as the crowd and coach rise in applause.
33.3: Faheem Ashraf digs it slightly short again, gently guided down to third man by Mendis.
33.4: Faheem Ashraf angles into the pads, clipping uppishly toward the leg side where Rathnayake is brilliantly denied by the fielder.
33.5: Faheem Ashraf angles in from outside off, eased down to long-on by Rathnayake.
33.6: Faheem Ashraf stays short outside off, guided down to square third man by Mendis.
34.1: Haris Rauf fires it full on the pads, clipped away neatly to deep square leg by Mendis.
34.2: Haris Rauf digs it in short, and Pavan Rathnayake mistimes his pull straight towards mid-wicket to steal a single.
34.3: Haris Rauf strays with his line on a back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Kamindu Mendis to slash it past the keeper all the way to the third man fence for four.
34.4: Haris Rauf spears this full delivery angling in, and Kamindu Mendis guides it to square third man to bring up the double century for Sri Lanka.
34.5: Haris Rauf rolls his fingers over a slower, fuller ball, and Pavan Rathnayake simply works it into the mid-wicket sector.
34.6: Haris Rauf goes to the off-cutter once more, and Pavan Rathnayake can only push it straight to point without finding a gap.
44.1: Janith Liyanage taps a full delivery toward mid-on for a brisk single, only to cop a painful blow to the neck from Shaheen Afridi's sharp return throw as the physio rushes onto the turf.
44.2: Haris Rauf outfoxes Pavan Rathnayake with a deceptive slower short ball, extracting a mistimed loft that floats straight to Babar Azam inside the circle.
44.3: Haris Rauf comes from round the wicket with a fuller length that Sahan Arachchige safely turns down the ground toward mid-on.
44.4: Haris Rauf angles a back-of-a-length delivery into the pads, eluding Janith Liyanage's bat as it ricochets off the thigh pad for a leg bye.
44.5: Haris Rauf nails a pinpoint yorker on off stump, leaving Sahan Arachchige just enough time to scramble and dig it out toward backward point.
44.6: Haris Rauf drops it shortish outside off, and Janith Liyanage expertly dabs it down to square third man for a comfortable single.
45.1: Shaheen Afridi hurls it full and tailing inward, forcing Janith Liyanage to work the delivery away toward mid-wicket for a single.
45.2: Shaheen Afridi slips in a precise, reversing yorker that Sahan Arachchige frantically digs out toward the cover region for one.
45.3: Shaheen Afridi drops it a fraction short outside off, allowing Janith Liyanage to cut it square through the off-side for a single.
45.4: Shaheen Afridi rolls his fingers across a slower delivery that sticks in the surface, inducing Sahan Arachchige to chip it aerially toward mid-wicket.
45.5: Shaheen Afridi deploys the off-cutter once more, trapping Sahan Arachchige as he fails to pierce the inner ring.
45.6: Shaheen Afridi angles one in sharply and full, eliciting a quick tap to cover from Sahan Arachchige to conclude a superb bowling stint.
46.1: Naseem Shah errs with a full back-of-the-hand slow leg-cutter, and Sahan Arachchige ruthlessly crashes it through the gap between extra cover and long-off for four.
46.2: Naseem Shah delivers from back of a length angling inward, prompting Sahan Arachchige to turn it toward wide mid-on for a single.
46.3: Naseem Shah digs out the low full-toss, and Janith Liyanage slices the aerial drive straight down the throat of Maaz Sadaqat prowling at deep point to depart for six.
49.1: Haris Rauf steams in and fires a sharp, shortish delivery right into the stumps, leaving Maheesh Theekshana swinging wildly into empty air.
49.2: Haris Rauf digs it in short on the stumps, forcing Maheesh Theekshana to duck underneath as the umpire tallies the first legal delivery of the over.
49.3: Haris Rauf searches a back of a length angling into the hips, allowing Maheesh Theekshana to clear room and whip it away toward backward square leg for a single.
49.4: Haris Rauf rolls out a clever, well-disguised slower ball on a fuller length that Asitha Fernando misses entirely, though quick running steals a sharp bye.
49.5: Haris Rauf delivers a shortish ball outside off which Maheesh Theekshana pulls into the fine leg gap, where Babar makes a brilliant stop in the deep despite sluggish running from the batter.

49.6: Haris Rauf targets the base of middle with a searing yorker that Asitha Fernando digs out to deep extra cover, but failing to ground his bat at the bowler's end results in a single short call by the umpire.
0.1: Asitha Fernando lands it on a crisp good length outside off, drawing Fakhar Zaman forward into a defensive prod that beats the outside edge completely.
0.2: Asitha Fernando pulls back his length around off, drawing a soft edge off Fakhar Zaman's defensive bat that rolls wide of slip to get him off the mark with a single.
0.3: Asitha Fernando serves up a back-of-a-length delivery wide of off, which Maaz Sadaqat stands tall to punch powerfully in front of square past cover-point all the way to the ropes.
0.4: Asitha Fernando maintains a tight good length just outside off, prompting Maaz Sadaqat onto his half-forward stride to dead-bat it safely into the off-side.
0.5: Asitha Fernando attacks just outside off on a short of a good length, catching the edge of Maaz Sadaqat's dangling bat as it scurries down to third man.
0.6: Asitha Fernando offers a low full toss outside off that Fakhar Zaman leans into, stroking it into the gap wide of cover to comfortably scamper back for a second run.
1.1: Dilshan Madushanka bowls a fuller length that swings away from the left‑hander, drawing Maaz Sadaqat into an expansive drive that is beaten on the outside edge.
1.2: Dilshan Madushanka delivers a good length ball just outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat gets right behind the line to defend it to the off‑side.
1.3: Dot ball from Dilshan Madushanka to Maaz Sadaqat.
12.3: Maheesh Theekshana floats it up outside off, inviting the drive from Saad Baig who punches it directly into the hands of the cover fielder.
12.4: Maheesh Theekshana slides it in flatter, prompting Saad Baig to create room and carve a sharp single past the cover ring.
12.5: Maheesh Theekshana tosses one up outside off, allowing Fakhar Zaman to stroke it down the ground toward long-on for a comfortable run.
12.6: Maheesh Theekshana loops it up on off stump, inviting Saad Baig to present a straight bat and push it back toward the bowler.
13.1: Janith Liyanage bangs it in short of a length, and Fakhar Zaman punches it past mid-wicket to hustle back for a bustling second run.
13.2: Janith Liyanage angles a good length delivery across the left-hander, and Fakhar Zaman guides it expertly down to third man for a single.
13.3: Janith Liyanage strays onto the pads, and Saad Baig effortlessly clips it behind square on the on-side to race away to the boundary ropes.
13.4: Janith Liyanage pulls back his length outside off, giving Saad Baig the room to slice a sharp square cut into the off-side for a single.
13.5: Janith Liyanage drops it on a good length around off, and Fakhar Zaman nudges it neatly into the leg side.
13.6: Janith Liyanage tests the back-foot with a shorter delivery outside off, which Fakhar Zaman mistimes straight into the mid-wicket fielder.
14.1: Sahan Arachchige begins his spell with a short and wide offering, dispatched by Saad Baig through point for a single.
14.2: Sahan Arachchige flights it outside off, and Fakhar Zaman drives cleanly into the vacant gap wide of cover to rotate the strike.
14.3: Sahan Arachchige lofts one up on middle, and Saad Baig steps back to nudge it securely toward long-off for a single.
14.4: Sahan Arachchige offers a fraction too much fullness, allowing Fakhar Zaman to punch it straight down to long-on for one.
14.5: Sahan Arachchige tosses it up around off stump, and Saad Baig eases the ball down to long-off for a comfortable single.
14.6: Sahan Arachchige drops it short and wide, prompting Fakhar Zaman to back away, play the late cut, and use the pace to beat backward point for a boundary.
15.1: Dilshan Madushanka hits a good length just outside off, inviting Saad Baig to punch off the back-foot straight to cover.
15.2: Dilshan Madushanka strays slightly, and Saad Baig dispatches the ball emphatically away to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
25.2: Dasun Shanaka drops it on a fuller length to middle, prompting Fakhar Zaman to punch it toward mid-off where a fumbled pickup gifts a rapid single.
25.3: Dasun Shanaka darts a full one straight into the channel on off, allowing Saad Baig to prod it safely onto the off-side.
25.4: Dasun Shanaka digs it short, letting Saad Baig get on top of the bounce and viciously pull it across the line to deep mid-wicket for four.
25.5: Dasun Shanaka pitches this one right up, inviting Saad Baig to present a straight bat and drill it hard toward deep extra cover for a brace.
25.6: Dasun Shanaka rolls out an off-cutter, and Saad Baig dead-bats it right back down the pitch to the bowler.
26.1: Maheesh Theekshana tosses one in with turn from outside off, and Fakhar Zaman drops to one knee to sweep it behind square to backward square leg for four.
26.2: Maheesh Theekshana drifts it through the air with some away turn, inducing Fakhar Zaman to stride forward and gently steer it to point.
26.3: Maheesh Theekshana flights it up as Fakhar Zaman skips down the track, dispatching it like a tracer bullet past the non-striker all the way to long-on for four.
26.4: Maheesh Theekshana takes pace off the delivery, and Fakhar Zaman tucks it away smoothly into the mid-wicket region for a single.
26.5: Maheesh Theekshana tosses up a harmless full ball that Saad Baig softly checks back to the bowler, who safely gobbles up the catch to snap a brilliant 74-run knock.
26.6: Maheesh Theekshana zips through a quicker delivery angling in, forcing Salman Agha onto the front foot to block it out.
27.1: Asitha Fernando serves up a full one on middle that Fakhar Zaman ruthlessly dances down to, launching it straight over the umpire's head into the sightscreen for a massive six.
27.2: Asitha Fernando drifts this length delivery into the pads, allowing Fakhar Zaman to clip it away toward deep square leg for a single.
27.3: Asitha Fernando rolls his fingers across this delivery outside off, and Salman Agha guides it gently down to third man for one.
27.4: Asitha Fernando drops in an off-cutter that Fakhar Zaman works toward mid-wicket, scrambling through for a tight single as Agha dawdles at the non-striker's end.
27.5: Asitha Fernando digs this slower ball in short, enabling Salman Agha to swivel on his heels and pull it down to fine leg for a run.
27.6: Asitha Fernando serves up a low full-toss, which Fakhar Zaman solidly pushes down the ground to long-on to rotate the strike.
39.1: Maheesh Theekshana lands a very full delivery on off, and Hasan Nawaz drives it firmly down to long-off for a single.
39.2: Maheesh Theekshana fires in a quicker, fuller ball at 91.9ks, which Arafat Minhas leans across to push toward long-off.
39.3: Maheesh Theekshana spears through an 87.6ks flatter delivery, prompting Hasan Nawaz to punch it down to long-off.
39.4: Maheesh Theekshana attacks from round the wicket with a 94.2ks drift, allowing Arafat Minhas to knock it cleanly toward long-on.
39.5: Maheesh Theekshana targets the stumps at 95.3ks, but Hasan Nawaz eases it past the diving mid-wicket fielder down to long-on.
39.6: Maheesh Theekshana slides a fuller ball into the pads, and Arafat Minhas pushes it to long-on to complete six singles in the over and retain the strike.
40.1: Dasun Shanaka drops a fullish ball onto the off stump, and Arafat Minhas strokes it out toward long-off.
40.2: Dasun Shanaka tests the corridor on a good length close to off, leaving Hasan Nawaz to prod it straight back to the bowler.
40.3: Dasun Shanaka digs it back of a length, and Hasan Nawaz gets on top of the bounce to knock it down to long-on.
40.4: Dasun Shanaka strays full and onto the legs, permitting Arafat Minhas to whip his wrists and flick it toward deep mid-wicket.
40.5: Dasun Shanaka watches Hasan Nawaz shuffle across the crease again before easing the delivery down to long-on.
40.6: Dasun Shanaka angles one across the left-hander, and Arafat Minhas flays it square of the wicket to retain the strike.
41.1: Dunith Wellalage keeps it straight from over the wicket, and Arafat Minhas retreats to punch a single through the leg side.
41.2: Dunith Wellalage darts it in with the arm at eighty-four point one kilometers per hour, allowing Hasan Nawaz to whip it briskly out to deep mid-wicket.
41.3: Dunith Wellalage drops it slightly short at eighty-five point two kilometers per hour, catching the toe of Arafat Minhas's bat as the lofted drive falls well shy of long-off.
46.3: Dilshan Madushanka slips in an off-pace delivery, and Arafat Minhas rocks back to mistime his pull out toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
46.4: Dilshan Madushanka targets the batsman with a sharper short delivery, forcing Hasan Nawaz to read it early and duck underneath to let it pass safely.
46.5: Dilshan Madushanka bangs in another well-directed bouncer, leaving Hasan Nawaz to sway out of its path as Mike Hesson argues in the dugout over a potential wide.
46.6: Dilshan Madushanka drifts a slower ball wide of off stump, but Hasan Nawaz reaches out to crack it in front of square past a diving sweeper for four.
47.1: Asitha Fernando misses his yorker length, and Arafat Minhas smokes it majestically over long-on to bring up a magnificent fifty under immense pressure inside a packed Gaddafi Stadium.
47.2: Asitha Fernando drops it full in the stumps again, and Arafat Minhas bludgeons back-to-back sixes with an even bigger blow launched straight down the ground.
47.3: Asitha Fernando gifts a wide full toss, and Arafat Minhas clears his front leg to hammer it straight down the ground for a boundary as victory approaches.
47.4: Asitha Fernando digs it short into the pitch, and a backing-away Arafat Minhas loops a top-edged pull off the splice straight back to the bowler for a brilliant 61.
47.5: Asitha Fernando strikes with a cutter banged into the pitch, inducing Faheem Ashraf to hole out to Maheesh Theekshana at third man for a golden duck.
47.6: Asitha Fernando sends down a 136.1kph full ball angled right into the stumps, and Shaheen Afridi calmly dead-bats the hat-trick delivery toward mid-on.
48.1: Dilshan Madushanka delivers a 131.9kph short-of-length ball, which Hasan Nawaz cleverly rides the bounce of to dab toward backward point and level the scores.
48.2: Dilshan Madushanka spears in a 131.1kph bouncer, and Shaheen Afridi throws the kitchen sink at a wild pull only to miss completely as it sails over.
48.3: Dilshan Madushanka digs it in short, and Shaheen Afridi stands tall to launch the pull over deep mid-wicket for six, sealing a thrilling three-wicket victory for Pakistan in the final.

preview.text: Pakistan and Sri Lanka meet in a one-day match at Gaddafi Stadium, where they have played 57 recorded one-day matches with Pakistan winning 35 and Sri Lanka winning 22. Pakistan won the toss and chose to bowl first. The usual first-innings score in the 32 recorded one-day matches at this venue is 282, and the forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 28 degrees.

summary.text: Pakistan won by 3 wkts. SL made 325-8, Kamindu Mendis top-scoring with 131 off 128 balls; Salman Agha took 2 for 44. PAK made 331-7, Fakhar Zaman top-scoring with 127 off 99 balls; Dilshan Madushanka took 3 for 63. Sides batting first at Gaddafi Stadium usually make about 282.
